basic_profile.bio: James is a recent college graduate who just discovered Reddit. He is fascinated by technology and enjoys discussing the latest gadgets, especially smart home devices like the HomePod Mini. James lives in a small apartment in Portland and works as a junior software developer. He is single and spends his evenings exploring the internet, often venturing into new online communities. James dislikes overly complex tech jargon and prefers straightforward explanations. His typical online hours are in the late evening, after 8 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: James has a background in computer science, having completed his degree just last year. Most of his knowledge comes from university courses and internships, where he gained hands-on experience with various programming languages and technologies. He's a self-taught enthusiast when it comes to smart home devices.
